note: Each register's partition names the raw delivered literal OldSecond; its parallel names Second. applied carries a reviewed `[[errata.field]] field = "column_name"` correction OldSecond -> Second: the parallel binds, Second becomes a state column, and the original keeps its delivered literal. drifted carries the same correction, but OldSecond's data length changed after review: a column correction guards every source field, so it and the parallel through it are stale. uncorrected has no correction, so no delivered literal is Second. applied's parallel reads its evidence pin from the built delivery (`read=built`): the digest covers the delivery's whole source revision, which DRIFTED's change moves, so a pin read from the reviewed delivery would stale it too.
fails_if: `compile_parallel_representations` matches the parallel's columns against the raw delivered Kolumnnamn instead of the checked effective literal, so applied's Second never binds and its parallel goes stale
